_comment: Adapter-level DSP/parsing config for the CWRU Bearing Data Center 12kHz Drive-End dataset (Phase 3.5). Consumed only by src/vib_agent/adapters/cwru.py — never by pdm_core. Not a pdm_core tunable, so it is not subject to the profiles.route whitelist; it configures signal *preprocessing* (envelope demodulation), not detector/gate/confidence logic.

starter_files._comment: Starter set (12 files): filename -> CWRU Bearing Data Center file number, for scripts/fetch_cwru.py. Normal baseline + 12k Drive-End fault data only (v1 scope). Verified: all 12 files' internal *_DE_time key numbers match their assigned file number (see tests/test_cwru_adapter.py investigation notes / Phase 3.5 close-out).

full_de_files._comment: Full 12k Drive-End set, v1 scope (Normal + IR + OR@6-centered + Ball, diameters 0.007/0.014/0.021in, all 4 loads = 40 files). Load suffix -> rpm via rpm_by_load_suffix. OR@3/OR@12 clock positions and 0.028in+ diameters remain out of v1 scope (never independently verified; not authorized). Each block's starting file number verified against the 12-file starter set (see starter_files); the load-1/2 extensions within an already-verified block are a direct, low-risk adjacency inference. B007 (0.007in ball) has NO verified anchor in this project — flagged accordingly in cwru_results.md if fetched.
